name: Recife/Guararapes - Gilberto Freyre International Airport
before:
The airport for Recife, 14 km from downtown, and one of the easiest arrivals in Brazil for a client without a transfer booked.

The metro connection is the reason. Recife's metro has a station a few metres from the terminal, reached by a covered walkway, so there is no shuttle and no weather to contend with. Buses also serve Boa Viagem and Cidade Universitária in Recife and Piedade in Jaboatão dos Guararapes.

The airport has been run by AENA Brasil since 2019. A new passenger terminal in 2004 lifted capacity from 1.5 million to 9 million passengers a year.

The runway was once 3,300 metres, but a modernisation in late 2023 added safety zones at both ends.

It began life in the Second World War and was a refuelling stop on the route from South America to Europe. Since December 2001 it has been named after Gilberto Freyre, the Recife-born anthropologist and sociologist.
after:
The airport for Recife, 11 km from the city centre. It is an easy arrival for a client without a transfer booked.

The metro connection is the reason: the Airport station, on the South Line, is the nearest station to the terminal.

Aena Brasil has run the airport since 2020.

It has been named after Gilberto Freyre, the Recife-born sociologist, since December 2001.

sources.quote: is an international airport serving Recife, Brazil

claims.note: Was '14 km from downtown'. The operator gives 11 km; the coordinates give 9.4 km in a straight line (209 degrees, south west), so 11 km is a ratio of 1.17 and Wikipedia's 14 km a ratio of 1.49. Both pass the tolerance; the operator's figure is used and Wikipedia's is dropped.

sources.quote: Localizado a 11 quilômetros do centro do município

claims.claim: Aena Brasil has run it since 2020
claims.inAfter: Aena Brasil has run the airport since 2020.
claims.note: Was 'run by AENA Brasil since 2019'. 2019 was the auction (15 March 2019, won by Aena Desarrollo Internacional: Agência Brasil); Aena says it has run the airport since March 2020, and Wikipedia's own traffic table switches from Infraero to AENA reports in 2020. DECEA's live entry names Aena Brasil as operator.

sources.quote: Administered by Aena Brasil since March 2020, after the company won the concession auction of the National Civil Aviation Agency (Anac) held in 2019
O maior lance foi do grupo espanhol Aena Desarrollo Internacional

claims.note: Was 'Recife's metro has a station a few metres from the terminal, reached by a covered walkway'. Aena names the Airport station on the South Line as the nearest and gives trains from 5am to 11pm; 'a few metres' and the covered walkway rest on Wikipedia alone, and the metro operator's pages sit on gov.br, which served this session a bot check.
